\]

\[
i^{11} + i^{111} = -i + (-i) = -2i
\]

This pattern repeats every 4 terms. Therefore, to find \(i^{11}\) and \(i^{111}\), we can use the modulo operation to determine the position of these powers within the cycle.

\[

\[
